ops.title: Match Cargo.toml's license to what vg-paradigms settles
ops.body: Cargo.toml says GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0, as the license.manifest rule asks, while LICENSE.md and REUSE.toml grant GPL-3.0-only WITH AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0. Re-render and re-check once the baseline settles one expression (or license-file), before publishing.
